title: HIVE Doctor — Visual Reference (original diagrams)
review_status: UNVERIFIED — educational schematic diagrams, original artwork. Not to scale; a reference aid, not a diagnosis.
note: Original vector diagrams authored for HIVE Doctor (owned artwork, offline, scalable). Schematic and simplified for teaching.

figures.title: Blood sugar & insulin
figures.caption: Insulin lets cells take up sugar. In diabetes this fails — sugar stays high.

<rect x="20" y="30" width="110" height="40" rx="8" fill="#13202e" stroke="#46c6ab"></rect><text x="75" y="48" text-anchor="middle" fill="#eef3f8" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11">Food → glucose</text><text x="75" y="63" text-anchor="middle" fill="#9fb0bf" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="9">blood sugar rises</text>
<rect x="155" y="30" width="110" height="40" rx="8" fill="#13202e" stroke="#46c6ab"></rect><text x="210" y="48" text-anchor="middle" fill="#eef3f8" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11">Pancreas</text><text x="210" y="63" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6fe0c8" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="9">releases insulin</text>

<line x1="130" y1="50" x2="153" y2="50" stroke="#9fb0bf" marker-end="url(#ai)"></line><line x1="265" y1="50" x2="288" y2="50" stroke="#9fb0bf" marker-end="url(#ai)"></line>

figures.title: Two arms of immunity
figures.caption: How the body fights infection — and what vaccines train.
